notes.title: NEW GAME: Idle Gumball Machine
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone, I'm making an idle/incremental game called Idle Gumball Machine. It's inspired by Nubby's Number Factory and Peggle. It's really fun, so go give it a wishlist to be notified of when it comes out![/p][p]Steam page: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3724490/Idle_Gumball_Machine/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]pls just wishlist it im desperate i need it please please[/p]

notes.title: 1.1 Update! QOL improvements and new item!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I'm pleased to announce a new update! I added the cloud in a bottle upgrade, which increases your jump height:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262607/d9b532c053b3c54ee6a8602221c39792553b1c40.png[/img]

I also improved the controller experience in the shop, made it so you can see the current level and loop numbers from the pause menu, and I added a button in the pause menu which allows you to see all your upgrades and stats at any time:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262607/be162b1036eeba7b305139b5dfcf9f4e21e9dc70.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262607/e0022c1dc62112419bf35bf99eddcda625f41c04.png[/img]

Thank you to everyone who has played the game!

-Vincent Poteet
